title: MSigDF: Molecular Signature Database (MSigDB) in a Data Frame
text: Original data Broad Institute’s Molecular Signature Database (MSigDB)1, redistributed separate gmt data files MSigDB. Procedure: 1. current MSigDB v2026.1 gmt files downloaded Broad ftp.2. done human mouse gene sets3. collection converted list R, written RData file using save(). See script data-raw/ see data frames (tibbles) created.

title: MSigDF: Molecular Signature Database (MSigDB) in a Data Frame
text: three data frames (tibbles) package. msigdf.human data frame columns MSigDB collection divided sub-collection (like cc, bp mf C5). format data tidy, row single gene set collection, sub-collection gene symbol. msigdf.mouse data frame structure mouse orthologs. msigdf.urls data frame links name gene set URL Broad’s website. New C5 ontology information added category subcode easy filtering consistency. HPO: Human Phenotype Ontology MF: GO Molecular Function ontology BP: GO Biological Process ontology CC: GO Cellular Component ontology data sets package several million rows. package imports tibble package ’re displayed nicely. Take look: Just get entries KEGG non-homologous end joining pathway: software, e.g., fGSEA might require gene sets named list genes identifiers, name element list name pathway. data originally structured, can return plyr::dlply(). , let’s use hallmark sets, dlply data named list format, get just first pathways, , just display first gene symbols.
